segments.en: How very pained I am for you — my dear beloved brother — for the great anguish of your suffering from your illness. I feel your pain in the very depths of my heart — for your pain is my pain. I always pray for your salvation and your good in body and soul. And especially now — I exert myself with all my strength to pray for your complete healing — speedily. May the Master of Mercy — Who hears the prayer of every mouth — hear my prayer and have mercy upon you. May He send His word and heal you speedily — and renew your strength — and add upon you years of good life — pleasant and fresh. And may you merit to see the revelation of the light of the true Tzadik — the Nachal Noavaya Mekor Chuchma — who will complete the repair of the world and return everyone to good.
